title: Lines without the stray empty one
hints: Look at what the starter returns for the first test. There is one item too many, and it is an empty string.
`split("\n")` treats the last `\n` as the start of one more line. Strings have another method made for lines.
explain: The reference returns `text.splitlines()`. It cuts the text at each line ending and does not invent an empty line after the last one. It also handles Windows line endings, which `split("\n")` leaves as a stray `\r` on every line.
